---
title: 'Appendix C — Seasonality (Figure C.1, Table C.1)'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, scales)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet")) |>
  mutate(quarter = factor(paste0("Q", quarter(date)), levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")))
data_monthly <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_monthly.parquet"))
```

## Figure C.1

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
col_pre     <- "#0E8A5F"
col_post    <- "#D9461E"
col_ink     <- "#6E6E68"
col_surface <- "#FFFFFF"

pal_evertreated <- c(
  "Never-treated (21)" = col_pre,
  "Ever-treated (29)"  = col_post
)

pal_linetype <- c(
  "Never-treated (21)" = "42",
  "Ever-treated (29)"  = "solid"
)

plot_df <- data |>
  mutate(group = if_else(ever_treated == 1, "Ever-treated (29)", "Never-treated (21)")) |>
  group_by(date, group) |>
  summarise(mean_y = mean(n_installations_per_1000), .groups = "drop")

x_min <- min(plot_df$date)
x_max <- max(plot_df$date)

years <- year(x_min):year(x_max)
shade_df <- tibble(
  xmin = as.Date(paste0(years, "-04-01")),
  xmax = as.Date(paste0(years, "-10-01"))
) |>
  filter(xmax >= x_min, xmin <= x_max)

pad <- 30  # days of horizontal breathing room around the data
shade_df <- shade_df |>
  mutate(xmin = pmax(xmin, x_min - pad), xmax = pmin(xmax, x_max + pad))

p_c1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    data = shade_df,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "#EDEDE7", alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_line(data = plot_df,
            aes(date, mean_y, colour = group, linetype = group, group = group),
            linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, group == "Never-treated (21)"),
             aes(date, mean_y, fill = group),
             shape = 21, colour = col_surface, size = 2.6, stroke = 1.1) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, group == "Ever-treated (29)"),
             aes(date, mean_y, fill = group),
             shape = 21, colour = col_surface, size = 2.6, stroke = 1.1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_evertreated, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_evertreated, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = pal_linetype, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y",
               expand = expansion(add = pad)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.10))) +
  labs(subtitle = "Shaded bands mark April–September",
       x        = NULL,
       y        = "New registrations per 1,000 inhabitants") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = col_surface, colour = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = col_surface, colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#E3E3DC", linewidth = 0.35),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = col_ink,
                                 margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = col_ink),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 9, colour = col_ink),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.direction     = "horizontal",
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = col_ink),
    legend.key.width     = unit(1.6, "cm"),
    legend.margin        = margin(t = 2, b = 6),
    legend.box.spacing   = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(18, 20, 12, 16)
  )

dir.create(here("figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(here("figures", "figure_C1_seasonality.png"), p_c1,
       width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = col_surface)

p_c1
```

## Table C.1, Panel A

```{r}
data |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(municipality_mean = mean(n_installations_per_1000)) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode, quarter) |>
  summarise(seasonal_deviation = mean(n_installations_per_1000 - municipality_mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  summarise(
    min    = min(seasonal_deviation),
    p25    = quantile(seasonal_deviation, 0.25),
    median = median(seasonal_deviation),
    mean   = mean(seasonal_deviation),
    p75    = quantile(seasonal_deviation, 0.75),
    max    = max(seasonal_deviation)
  )
```

## Table C.1, Panel B

```{r}
data |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(change = treatment - lag(treatment)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(change == 1) |>
  count(quarter, name = "activations") |>
  mutate(share = activations / sum(activations))
```

## Calendar months of activations in the monthly panel

```{r}
data_monthly |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(change = treatment - lag(treatment)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(change == 1) |>
  summarise(distinct_calendar_months = n_distinct(month(date)))
```
